# field of fractions　`def.field-of-fractions`
English entry · root `../`
[in graph](../#n=def.field-of-fractions)　·　[Chinese page (authoritative)](./def.field-of-fractions.md)

⚠ The ring must be an **integral domain**: with zero divisors the equivalence class of $\frac{a}{s}$ degenerates ($s$ may become a zero divisor) and the construction fails.

⭐ The field of fractions is "the smallest field containing $A$"; the universal property says exactly this.

> Proofs of the edges are still Chinese only: `proofs/`; the Chinese page remains authoritative.
